# Structured_Temporal_Modeling

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A design principle that imposes explicit structural constraints on how temporal information is aggregated across time steps in spiking networks. Provides a systematic way to manage temporal dependencies, improving robustness and interpretability in both TCC and iNEST pipelines.
